$comment: Metafield and metaobject definitions as code (P3A-02, SHOPIFY_DATA_MODEL). Applied by apply-definitions.mjs. Order matters: a metaobject definition may only reference types declared before it. Validation values may be written as arrays; the script JSON-encodes them as the Admin API requires. UNVERIFIED(V-05): everything here is checked against the Admin GraphQL 2026-10 reference but not yet against a development store.

metaobjectDefinitions.name: Brand
metaobjectDefinitions.description: Brand details shown on brand pages and product pages (REQ-CAT-006, REQ-COL-005).

fieldDefinitions.name: Slug
fieldDefinitions.description: Lowercase, hyphenated; must equal the metaobject handle so the product importer can find the brand.

fieldDefinitions.name: Hero image
fieldDefinitions.description: Optional. A wide picture shown beside the brand name at the top of the brand page. Leave empty for the plain header.

metaobjectDefinitions.name: FAQ
metaobjectDefinitions.description: Questions and answers for collection and product pages.

fieldDefinitions.name: Scope
fieldDefinitions.description: Where it applies, for example a collection handle or product handle. Values are agreed in P3B.

metaobjectDefinitions.name: Quiz scoring rule
metaobjectDefinitions.description: One plain-language scoring rule for a quiz answer: when the shopper picks the answer, products with this attribute value score higher, lower, or are left out (REQ-QZ-003, REQ-QZ-004, NFR-005, P6-13).

fieldDefinitions.name: Name
fieldDefinitions.description: Staff-facing label, for example 'Side sleeper: boost Plush'. Not shown to shoppers.

fieldDefinitions.name: Attribute
fieldDefinitions.description: What the rule looks at. 'size' picks the size whose price and stock are used; 'budget' sets a price limit in whole dollars.

fieldDefinitions.name: Value
fieldDefinitions.description: The attribute value, spelled as in the product attributes, for example Plush, Hybrid, Side, Cooling, Queen. For 'budget' this is the maximum price in whole dollars, for example 1500.

fieldDefinitions.name: Effect
fieldDefinitions.description: 'boost' adds the weight to matching products (a negative weight lowers them); 'exclude' removes matching products from the results. Empty means boost. Ignored for 'size' and 'budget'.

fieldDefinitions.name: Weight
fieldDefinitions.description: Whole number from -10 to 10, not 0. Larger counts for more. Needed for 'boost'; ignored for 'exclude', 'size' and 'budget'.

fieldDefinitions.name: Budget minimum (dollars)
fieldDefinitions.description: Only for 'budget': an optional lower price limit in whole dollars.

metaobjectDefinitions.name: Quiz option
metaobjectDefinitions.description: One answer in the sleep quiz with its declarative scoring rules (REQ-QZ-003, REQ-QZ-004).

fieldDefinitions.name: Scoring rules (advanced JSON)
fieldDefinitions.description: Fallback for developers: a JSON list of rules (attribute, value, weight, exclude). Used only when the 'Rules' field below is empty. Prefer 'Rules'.

fieldDefinitions.name: Rules
fieldDefinitions.description: Scoring rules for this answer (up to 12). When any are set they replace the JSON field above (P6-13).

metaobjectDefinitions.name: Quiz question
metaobjectDefinitions.description: One question in the sleep quiz.

metaobjectDefinitions.name: Homepage card
metaobjectDefinitions.description: One card or step inside a homepage block: the cards of 'setup-cards' and the steps of 'how-it-works' (CR-31, REQ-HOME-001).

fieldDefinitions.name: Title
fieldDefinitions.description: Heading of the card or step. A card without a title is not shown.

fieldDefinitions.name: Text
fieldDefinitions.description: One or two short paragraphs. Plain text; a blank line starts a new paragraph.

fieldDefinitions.name: Image
fieldDefinitions.description: Optional picture for the card (used by 'setup-cards').

fieldDefinitions.name: Link
fieldDefinitions.description: Relative path or https URL. Plain text on purpose: Shopify's url type rejects relative paths. The storefront validates it against an allow-list (T-08).

fieldDefinitions.name: Link label
fieldDefinitions.description: Text of the card's button. Leave empty to make the title itself the link.

metaobjectDefinitions.name: Homepage section
metaobjectDefinitions.description: An editable, orderable block on the homepage (REQ-HOME-001).

fieldDefinitions.name: Type
fieldDefinitions.description: Section kind. hero, promo-banner, financing, quiz-band and faq use heading, body, image and link; setup-cards and how-it-works use Cards; shop-by-size, featured, brands, categories and signup need only heading, order, enabled.

fieldDefinitions.name: Heading
fieldDefinitions.description: In hero, quiz-band, setup-cards, how-it-works and faq, write [[a phrase]] in double square brackets to highlight it in red. Other types show the plain text.

fieldDefinitions.name: Link
fieldDefinitions.description: Relative path or https URL. Plain text on purpose: Shopify's url type rejects relative paths. The storefront validates it against an allow-list (T-08).

fieldDefinitions.name: Link label
fieldDefinitions.description: Text of the button for the link. Leave empty to make the heading itself the link. Added in P3B-13 so a link never needs generic wording like 'Learn more'.

fieldDefinitions.name: Order
fieldDefinitions.description: Smaller numbers appear first. Entries without a whole number go last.

fieldDefinitions.name: Enabled
fieldDefinitions.description: A section shows only when this is on.

fieldDefinitions.name: Cards
fieldDefinitions.description: For setup-cards (first 3 are shown) and how-it-works (first 6, numbered in this order). Add Homepage card entries here.

metaobjectDefinitions.name: Promo tile
metaobjectDefinitions.description: A tile shown inside a collection grid (REQ-COL-003).

fieldDefinitions.name: Position in grid
fieldDefinitions.description: 1 puts the tile first, 4 makes it the fourth cell, counting products and tiles together. A tile whose position is beyond the products shown is held back until 'Load more' brings enough products.

fieldDefinitions.name: Heading
fieldDefinitions.description: Shown on the tile and used as the link text.

fieldDefinitions.name: Link
fieldDefinitions.description: Relative path or https URL; validated by the storefront (T-08). Without a valid link the tile is shown but is not clickable.

fieldDefinitions.name: Enabled
fieldDefinitions.description: A tile shows only when this is on.

fieldDefinitions.name: Colour
fieldDefinitions.description: Optional. The tile's colour: red (the default), dark (black) or light (cream with dark text). Empty or anything else shows red.

metaobjectDefinitions.name: Offer rule
metaobjectDefinitions.description: Declarative add-on offer placed before checkout (REQ-PRE-002, REQ-PRE-003). Rules are data, not code.

fieldDefinitions.name: Name
fieldDefinitions.description: Staff-facing label. Added to the data model so the admin list is readable.

fieldDefinitions.name: Price source
fieldDefinitions.description: Where the price comes from. Values finalised in Phase 4.

metaobjectDefinitions.name: Site settings
metaobjectDefinitions.description: Single entry with global settings (REQ-NAV-001, REQ-CART-004, REQ-PRE-003).

fieldDefinitions.name: Promo bar link
fieldDefinitions.description: Relative path or https URL; validated by the storefront (T-08).

fieldDefinitions.name: Support phone
fieldDefinitions.description: US number shown in the site header, footer and menu, for example (312) 555-0100. Anything that is not a valid US number is ignored; the deployment setting PUBLIC_SUPPORT_PHONE overrides it when set.

fieldDefinitions.name: Haul-away maximum pieces
fieldDefinitions.description: The same number is set by hand in the Shopify Flow condition; change both together.

fieldDefinitions.name: Extend enabled (mirror)
fieldDefinitions.description: Non-secret mirror of the feature flag.

metaobjectDefinitions.name: Delivery zone
metaobjectDefinitions.description: The single in-home delivery zone (ADR-0007). The postal codes mirror Shopify Local delivery; check-delivery-parity.mjs compares them.

fieldDefinitions.name: Postal codes
fieldDefinitions.description: Comma, space or line separated. A trailing * is a wildcard prefix, for example 100*. Kept as text, not a list, because Local delivery accepts one text field of up to 3,000 characters (F-28).

fieldDefinitions.name: Free delivery over
fieldDefinitions.description: The single source of the free-delivery threshold: the delivery quote, the cart progress message and the Local delivery price rule all use this amount.

metafieldDefinitions.name: Sleep positions
metafieldDefinitions.description: Back, Side, Stomach. Allowed values are enforced by the product sheet validator: Shopify does not support the choices validation on list types.

metafieldDefinitions.name: Benefits
metafieldDefinitions.description: Cooling, Pressure Relief, Motion Separation, Back Support, Eco-Friendly. Enforced by the sheet validator (no choices validation on list types).

metafieldDefinitions.name: Specifications
metafieldDefinitions.description: List of { label, value } pairs for the product page.

metafieldDefinitions.name: Feature bullets
metafieldDefinitions.description: Overview bullets for the product page.

metafieldDefinitions.name: Brand
metafieldDefinitions.description: Brand sections. The vendor field is kept for filters.

metafieldDefinitions.name: Compare group
metafieldDefinitions.description: Products with the same value are offered as similar products.

metafieldDefinitions.name: Extend category
metafieldDefinitions.description: Extend protection category (REQ-EXT-005). Shape confirmed by Q-005.

metafieldDefinitions.name: FAQs
metafieldDefinitions.description: Collection page FAQs (REQ-COL-004). Same shape as the product metafield; the collection page shows them and emits FAQ structured data from the same entries.

metafieldDefinitions.name: Sleep quiz result
metafieldDefinitions.description: Saved sleep quiz result: { v, savedAt, configFingerprint, answers, handles }, under 4 KB. Read and written through the Customer Account API (P6-04, REQ-QZ-005), not the Storefront API. UNVERIFIED(V-08): customer-account READ_WRITE in namespace custom.
